steps_items.heading: Confirm Your CAPM Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires only a secondary degree and completion of project management education hours—no prior work experience needed. This makes certification ideal for Pensacola professionals entering project roles across defense, healthcare, aviation, and other sectors. Verify your education credentials before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of PM Education
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy delivers this requirement through live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp training. Our intensive format compresses learning into focused sessions, fitting working professionals' schedules. You'll study core project management frameworks and processes aligned with PMI standards.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After coursework completion, create your PMI account and submit your CAPM application directly to the Project Management Institute. You'll pay the exam fee at this stage. Granite PM Academy staff can guide you through the submission process.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides exam-preparation resources to reinforce your knowledge. The CAPM exam tests your understanding of project management domains and terminology. You'll sit for the proctored exam on a schedule that works for you.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your CAPM Credential
steps_items.text: CAPM credentials renew on a three-year cycle. You'll earn professional development units (PDUs) through continued learning, training, and project work. Staying current keeps your credential active and signals ongoing commitment to your profession.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.
